## Description

A short, clear description of what the project does and what it demonstrates.

## Project Overview (optional)

- Project name:  
- Starter Kit: (Vision / LiDAR / IO-Link)  
- Affiliation: (e.g. University of Stuttgart, Community)  
- Contact person:  
- Difficulty: (Beginner / Intermediate / Advanced)  
- Estimated duration:

## Hardware Requirements (optional)

List any additional hardware beyond the Starter Kit.

## Software Requirements (optional)

List required software, libraries, or dependencies.

## Current Status (optional)

- [ ] Idea phase  
- [ ] In development  
- [ ] Completed and ready to submit

## Questions / Notes (optional)

Any open questions or notes for the SICK team before submitting a Pull Request.

---

### Notes

- You don't need to fill in every field. Fill in only what you know — the  
  more details, the faster we can give you feedback.  
- Only the Description is really needed. All other sections are optional.  
- Replace the placeholder text under each heading with your own input, and  
  delete sections you don't need.  
- You can ignore the Assignee, Project and Milestone fields at the bottom.  
  Please leave them empty — the SICK team reviews new proposals and assigns  
  them to the right person.
